newsitem.title: GERMANY: BASF buys polystyrene business of Monsanto, Unigel.
newsitem.headline: BASF buys polystyrene business of Monsanto, Unigel.

text.p: German chemicals group BASF AG said on Monday its Brazilian subsidiary BASF SA, Sao Paulo, had acquired the polystyrene business run jointly by Monsanto and Brazil's Unigel group.
BASF said in a statement the parties had decided not to disclose the purchase price.
BASF said the purchase will make it the second largest producer of polystyrene in the Mercosur trade bloc which comprises Brazil, Argentina, Uruguay and Paraguay.
Annual capacity will be 50,000 tonnes a year at Sao Jose dos Campos in the province of Sao Paolo.
